insights.one_liner: Verisure provides monitored home and small-business security across Europe and Latin America; one Amsterdam IT and security role needs no Dutch, but it is not a visa sponsor.

culture.text: Verisure does product development, design, sales, installation and 24/7 monitoring in-house, serving over 6 million customers in 18 countries.

open.text: It is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: Verisure posted a EUR 65.7 million profit in the first half of 2026 and announced its first dividend.
It is expanding its AI video detector GuardVision Outdoor to 12 countries.
It bought smart-intercom startup Kivala for EUR 6 million.

worth_knowing.text: The CEO says Verisure is betting on AI partnerships to meet competition, including an exclusive European deal with US-based Ting Labs.
Its products won two 2026 Red Dot design awards.
